report.verdict: Your security recruiting at Halden AI is a strong match for Meridian's work, and the offer numbers back it up. I'd want to talk to you. I'd ask what your current searches involve from sourcing through close.
write_up: You bring security recruiting at Halden AI, people leadership at Tessera Labs, and machine learning hiring at Orbis. For Meridian's security recruiter role, the recruiting results are compelling, though the resume says less about how you run a current search from start to finish.

The Orbis mentorship line is a great model: it names who you trained, how you trained them, and the hires that followed. One figure needs another look: a 250% reduction in time to hire isn't mathematically possible as written.

Let's start with your work with the CISO, then correct the time-to-hire figure and name your part in the Orbis funnel initiatives. Bring your full-cycle recruiting and reporting work closer to the top for Meridian, and add your sourcing and closing methods if you can substantiate them.

cards.line: Hiring point-of-contact for the Chief Information Security Officer.
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can see who you worked with, but not what you handled together. That partnership matters for a job working directly with technical leaders.
cards.example: Hiring point-of-contact for the Chief Information Security Officer, coordinating [hiring work]
cards.question: What hiring work did you coordinate with the Chief Information Security Officer?

cards.line: Rebuilt the company's hiring process, achieving a 250% reduction in time to hire within five months.
cards.cannot_tell: A reduction can't exceed 100% of the original time, so this figure will make a recruiter pause. The time before and after the rebuild would show what changed.
cards.example: Rebuilt the company's hiring process, changing time to hire from [prior time to hire] to [new time to hire] within five months
cards.question: What were the time-to-hire figures before and after the rebuild?

cards.line: Played a key role in funnel initiatives, contributing to 800+ machine learning hires and reporting results to recruiting leadership.
cards.cannot_tell: The hiring total is substantial, but a recruiter can't tell what you contributed to the funnel initiatives. Your part matters more than the total alone.
cards.example: Played a key role in funnel initiatives by [your contribution], contributing to 800+ machine learning hires and reporting results to recruiting leadership
cards.question: What did you do on the funnel initiatives?

cards.line: Trained 60 non-ML sourcers through a structured mentorship program, resulting in 90 additional hires in Q3 2022.
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It ties your own work to a hiring result without making a recruiter guess what the program did.
